description:
[0.98.5a-RC9] Space fauna 1.0.0

Download link

Adds a new faction to the sector. It's not a normal major or minor faction, the closest thing in vanilla I can compare it to is the Remnants or the Domain drones. The fleets are located in uncolonized systems scattered throughout the sector. The main mechanic added by this mod is the study and research of this new faction. New mechanics, interactions, and various bonuses will be unlocked through research.

Should be safe to add mid-save. Can't be removed after.

Features
5 ships (not ownable by the player for now)
6 hullmods
4 industries
5 special items
1 bar mission, 5 contact missions, 1 new contact type
Various fleet interactions
20 misc bonuses unlocked through research

I know it's kind of vague, but since the main mechanic is research, I thought putting all the details here would probably ruin the fun.
Show me anyway
Are you sure?
Yes

5 ships (not ownable by the player for now)

6 hullmods

4 industries

Fauna research center

A highly specialized research facility dedicated to the study, genetic analysis, and technological synthesis of Tiyanki biology. Equipped with advanced containment pods and bio-mechanical manipulation arrays, it analyzes specimens to unlock unique biological insights, tactical data, and specialized tech applications derived from space fauna.

Ranger lodge

Serves as an operational base for managing and protecting system-wide space fauna. Increases the maximum Tiyanki population limit and gradually regenerates a portion of purged population each month. Due to extreme logistical complexity, only one Ranger Lodge can be constructed per star system.

Space Ranching

A specialized orbital facility designed to monitor, herd, and harvest local space megafauna within the system. Production output scales directly with the abundance of native fauna. However, operations rely heavily on system-wide ranching fleets. If these ranchers are destroyed or disrupted, production will temporarily stall until operations are restored.

Volatiles vents

Massive planetary extraction arrays that vent high concentrations of ambient volatiles directly into space. By enriching the local vacuum with these gaseous nutrients, the facility sustains a thriving ecosystem, significantly boosting the local Tiyanki population growth and spawn rates within the system.

5 special items
Tiyanki biomass

A collection of organic tissues salvaged from a fallen Tiyanki carcass. Although harvesting megafauna is a delicate process, the dense concentration of adaptive genetic material makes this biomass exceptionally valuable for biological research and industrial-scale synthesis.

Tiyanki scale

A batch of heavy dermal scales salvaged from Tiyanki remains. Beyond their natural structural toughness, they exhibit exceptional resistance to EMP surges, making them highly prized for reinforcing sensitive electronic systems and shielding.

Elder Tiyanki gem

An organic crystalline growth developed within elder, combat-specialized Tiyanki phenotypes. Highly responsive to directed energy, it can be integrated into ship weapon systems to significantly amplify energy damage output.

The shattered remains of an organic Tiyanki bio-gem. Due to the extreme volatility of the extraction process, the sensitive crystalline structure has suffered catastrophic collapse, rendering the specimen entirely inert and valueless for weapon integration.

Tiyanki phase organ

A rare phase-inducing organ recovered from Tiyanki megafauna. Capable of bending local spacetime to shift the creature into phase, this tissue can be adapted by ship engineers to generate a passive defensive envelope that reduces incoming damage.

A damaged and non-functional phase organ extracted from a Tiyanki. Improper harvesting techniques have caused the fragile biological components to degrade, destroying any capability to generate or stabilize a phase field.

Tiyanki system data

This TriPad contains a detailed survey database cataloging the biological and ecological parameters of a star system inhabited by Tiyanki pods, formatted according to Domain Xenobiology Directorate standards. Data such as this is an essential asset for conservation initiatives, xenobiological research, and sustainable harvesting ventures.

1 bar mission, 5 contact missions, 1 new contact type
Bar mission / contact mission
Increase/decrease specific Tiyanki system population (Allows the recruitment of the scientist contact type)

Contact mission
Buy/sell Tiyanki special items
Raid/resupply research outpost
Rent/offer Tiyanki knowledge capacity
Improve contact importance

Various fleet interactions
Basic Interactions
Scan the fleets to acquire the relevant research data
Feed the fleets to increase the in-system population
Scare off the fleet to make it return to its home planet

Medium Interactions
Enable nest scan
Nest population bonus improvement
Nest hatch probability improvement
Tiyanki migration assistance in/out of system
Matriarch speed up/slow down migration cycle
Enables Matriarch tracker

Advanced Interactions
Matriarch raid options
Matriarch heal options
Matriarch select/stop migration cycle

20 misc bonuses unlocked through research

Level 1
New Hullmod (Bio-organic beam emitter): Unlocks a hullmod that enhances the effectiveness of all mounted beam weapons.
Tiyanki relays: Your fleet uses nearby Tiyanki pods as living communication relays, extending its sensor reach. +200 sensor range while inside a Tiyanki system.
New Hullmod (Integrated scale armor): Unlocks a hullmod that reinforces hull plating and weapon mounts with harvested Tiyanki scales.
Tiyanki interaction matrix: A behavioural model that lets you approach Tiyanki pods without alarming them. +15 base relation.
Basic Tiyanki behaviour study: Unlocks basic interactions with all types of Tiyanki.
New Industry (Volatiles vents): Unlocks a colony facility dedicated to large-scale volatile extraction, making the system more attractive to the Tiyanki.
Advanced butchering techniques: Improves the yield and quality of materials harvested from Tiyanki. Gems and organs are far more likely to be recovered intact, and other special items are found 50% more often.
New Hullmod (Tiyanki components): Unlocks a hullmod that replaces standard internal machinery with grown biological equivalents, removing the need for supplies during routine maintenance.

Level 2
New Industry (Space ranching): Unlocks a colony industry dedicated to the controlled rearing and large-scale harvesting of Tiyanki pods.
Long-range scan: Sensor burst now scans nearby Tiyanki fleets.
New Hullmod (Elder gem emitter): Unlocks a hullmod that integrates Tiyanki gems into the focusing arrays of a single energy weapon, greatly enhancing it.
Advanced Tiyanki biology study: Unlocks advanced interactions with Tiyanki and the full egg interaction tree.
Synthetic Tiyanki pheromones: Your ships emit synthetic pheromones that Tiyanki pods recognise as familiar. +20 base relation.
New Hullmod (Organic phase field): Biological phase fields work on fundamentally different principles from artificial ones. Unlocks a hullmod that adapts some of their unique properties to ship systems.

Level 3
Space lane Tiyanki crossing: Colony traffic is routed around Tiyanki migration paths, disturbing the pods far less. Colony impact on Tiyanki systems is reduced by 2 per colony size.
New Industry (Ranger lodge): Unlocks a colony industry dedicated to sustaining and protecting the local Tiyanki population.
Hullmod improvements: Unlocks advanced hullmod upgrades that use Tiyanki special items.
Perfect Tiyanki mimicry: Your fleets mimic Tiyanki signals so closely that the pods treat them as their own. +40 base relation with all Tiyanki.

Level 4
Special system (Tiyanki Haven): Long-range sensor sweeps have charted the precise coordinates of a truly exceptional Tiyanki system.
Complete Tiyanki understanding: Nothing is beyond your grasp. Unlocks full Matriarch interactions and every remaining knowledge bonus.

AI use disclaimer
All graphics and some code in this mod were created using AI tools:
Code: Claude/ Gemini/ Perplexity (ordered by use).
I had to use some AI assistance for the more complex mechanics:
Matriarch wandering and phase animation, which, by the way, still doesn't completely work correctly, but I gave up trying to fix it further than it is
After manually writing the code, if I encountered a bug while playing, I first used AI to check for common errors. For example, saving values like the level in the hullmod upgrade system used to not work in modular ships

Graphics: Google Flow
The base image was drawn by me or vanilla images were used as reference images, then they were iterated upon until I had the final results.

This mod is still incomplete, probably about a 1/3 content complete. I still wanted to post it since feature creep was kicking my ass and I was worried I might have overlooked some massive bug that would be too hard to remove later on. Anyway, thanks for checking out my mod, and I hope you enjoy it. As always, any suggestion is welcome.

Future plans
Adding more POIs, similar to the Red Planet quest.
Making fauna ships available to the player
Adding rundown facilities to planets with ruins in Tiyanki systems
Adding 2 other fauna types with all related content
